outcome: Operative delivery due to non-reassuring fetal heart rate (NRFHR)
cohort: Pregnancies who underwent induction of labor by either a single slow-release vaginal insert of 10 mg PGE2 or serial administration of 3 mg vaginal PGE2 tablets
finding: Slow-release PGE2 vaginal insert achieves cervical ripening and subsequently delivery over a shorter time period than PGE2 tablets, without increasing uterine hyperstimulation rate.
